title: Diakrisis evidence-linked finding — contract revision 2 (experimental)
description: Machine-readable evidence-bound advisory finding. Contract revision is independent of the single Diakrisis suite SemVer; schema validity does not imply factual accuracy.

schema_version.description: Wire-format revision, not an individual skill version. Revision 2 since 2026-10-27; see REVIEW-CONTRACT.md for migration from revision 1.

span.description: Quoted phrase or exact location in the inspected artifact; no fabricated excerpts.

category.description: Free text so consumers can extend it. Diakrisis skills and fixtures use the documented vocabulary in $defs (category-<reviewer> and category-any-reviewer).

claim.description: Bounded finding or explicit unresolved question; an abstention must not assert an established defect.

source.description: Actual filename/URL/identifier; not merely a source imagined to exist.

verification.description: Whether this source itself was actually inspected for the cited assertion.

applicability.description: Applicability is contextual to the examined artifact and its declared authority.

severity.description: Impact estimate by consequence for the reader's decision; not a workflow blocked state, approval or confidence.

confidence_reason.description: Grounded rationale; not a fabricated numeric confidence score.

issue_key.description: Optional shared underlying issue; coordinator must inspect content before deduplicating.

related_findings.description: IDs of genuinely related findings, not an assertion of independent evidence.

severity.description: Severity levels defined by consequence (contract revision 2).

oneOf.description: No change is needed to keep the meaning or validity: context, a question or an abstention.
A reader may be slowed or briefly misled, but the main claim, definition, method or decision survives as written.
A main claim, definition, method step or decision is unsupported, contradicted or likely misread as written; fixing it changes what the text asserts.
A result or decision others rely on is invalid under the governing authority; the reviewer proposes resolving it before acceptance. Never the Project Record Standard Blocked flag.
